items.title: Reddit (RDDT) Stock Is Up, What You Need To Know
items.summary: Shares of online community and discussion platform Reddit (NYSE:RDDT) jumped 4.9% in the afternoon session after The Information reported that Meta Platforms is preparing to launch a consumer AI agent named Hatch that is trained to access and browse the social discussion platform. According to coverage of the upcoming launch, Hatch will allow users to navigate Reddit, order from DoorDash, shop on Etsy, check Yelp, and manage Microsoft Outlook directly inside Meta’s ecosystem.
